text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I truly respect how you forge and polish 
yourself day after day as a dedicated, 
diligent Umamusume. Please continue to 
strive for excellence.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks. Having Rudolf celebrate it 
with me is such a huge honor.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, you'd better watch out, okay? If 
you keep acting so carefree all the time, 
one day I'll take a big bite out of you♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have never once felt relaxed when facing 
you. ...No matter how gentle and sincere 
you may appear, a monster is still a 
monster.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For someone known as the "Emperor" to be 
cheerfully devoured with a smile... that 
is simply unacceptable.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you might not see the monster's true 
expression until you're already being 
devoured, you know?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That will not happen. I shall valiantly 
defeat the fleeing monster, and 
demonstrate my dignity as the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I want you to be a 
monster worth slaying.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then I've gotta rise to the 
occasion. From here on out, I'm gonna keep 
on kicking it into high gear and blow 
everyone away♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have high expectations of you, little 
"Monster."
